before.exam_tip_html: When a question asks you to compare the two set works, do not just describe each in turn and stop — examiners reward explicit linking language such as ‘whereas Bach relies on terraced dynamics because Baroque instruments could not vary volume gradually, Beethoven exploits the fortepiano’s new capacity for gradual crescendo to build tension’; a common mistake is writing two separate mini-essays with no connecting sentence at all, which loses the marks reserved for genuine comparison.
